# Other Commands

### maxdata &lt;megabytes&gt; { #maxdata data-toc-label="maxdata" }

Sets the room for the data files your mod's Lua script saves. Goes in the .c5se or on a `#!@` line, once.

- **megabytes:** 1 to 100. Without the line, 10. A save that would go past it fails, and CoE5SE deletes nothing to make room.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    maxdata 20
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@maxdata 20
    ```

### expand_ritual_table { #expand-ritual-table data-toc-label="expand_ritual_table" }

Does nothing. Older mods that carry the line still load.

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    expand_ritual_table
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@expand_ritual_table
    ```

### Example { #example }

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    maxdata 20
    expand_ritual_table
    ```

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@maxdata 20
    #!@expand_ritual_table
    ```
